fact: In July 2023 ANPTIC's director general said RESINA interconnects regions, provinces and communes, and that its extension to 45 additional communes is planned by 2026, with insufficient funds and high connection costs among the difficulties.
title: Vulgarisation des politiques, projets et programmes du MTDPCE : L'ANPTIC éclaire le RJPEN sur l'interconnexion des bâtiments administratifs au RESINA
publisher: Agence Nationale de Promotion des TIC
